title: Required construction documents.
officialText:
In addition to the requirements of Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code, the
applicant shall submit any and all of the documents specified in Sections 107.3 through 107.15 as appropriate to the nature and extent
of the work proposed.
